hypothesis: A resolved taper must shrink both lateral intensity-profile edges after local contrast normalization; a constant-width contrast fade must not supply taper evidence.
policy: Parameters fixed before mechanism execution. No threshold lowering, alternate directions, seeds or annotation inputs. Source unavailable/boundary evidence refuses. Taper evidence alone is not terminal or ownership proof. Pixel-identical causes must receive identical decisions. No production imports or Length adapter.
stopCondition: Reject this operator if pure amplitude fade yields resolved taper evidence, or if distinguishable taper cannot be measured on controlled supported profiles. Any revision is separately recorded before evaluation.
